title: Amount of the Electrical Diagnostic Charge: Workmanship Warranties Billing Note
content:
**Billing rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the electrical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty concern is the plan's standard diagnostic fee, charged in full once for the concern, in US dollars rounded to the cent. The charge is never below zero.

## Elements of the rule

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Amount | The plan's standard diagnostic fee, as the plan's rate card states it for the plan the coverage is held under |
| Extent | Charged in full |
| Frequency | Once for the concern |
| Precision | US dollars, rounded to the cent |
| Floor | Never below zero |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

With a hypothetical standard diagnostic fee of USD 92.50, the electrical diagnostic charge for one concern is USD 92.50, charged once and in full.

Q. If two electrical-part concerns on the coverage are found not covered, how many charges are there?
A. One for each concern: the charge is posted once for the concern, and each not-covered electrical-part concern is its own concern.
